# CANDIDATE: PRIOR_DAY_HIGH_BOS_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-10
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A clean break of the prior day’s high accompanied by a bullish market‑structure BOS (higher high) and above‑average volume signals continuation of the prior day’s momentum. This setup aims to capture intraday trend continuation by requiring both price action (break of prior day high) and market structure confirmation (BOS) with volume validation.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When price closes above the prior day’s high, the bar forms a higher high (BOS) relative to the most recent swing high, and the 5‑minute volume exceeds the 20‑period average volume, enter long at the close of that bar. Exit shape: Stop placed at the prior day’s low or the low of the breakout bar, whichever is higher; target set at 2× the risk (entry‑stop distance); runner trailed with a 10‑% ATR‑based chandelier exit. Regime hint: Best when the prior day closed in the upper half of its range and the current day’s VIX is below 20, indicating persisting bullish bias; avoid when the prior day was a strong reversal day or when VIX > 30.
